evals.name: add-pinned-column
evals.prompt: セクションをピン留めできるようにしたいので、まずDB側だけ準備して。memo に pinned フラグを追加して、マイグレーションまで作って。
evals.expected_output: Schema column with default, named generated migration, local apply, tests pass.
assertions: worker/board/schema.ts gains a pinned column that is nullable or has a constant default
A new drizzle/0009_*.sql migration exists with a descriptive name (not a random drizzle-kit name like 0009_happy_hulk)
drizzle/meta snapshot and _journal.json were produced by drizzle-kit (real UUID ids, not hand-written) and match the migration
The migration SQL is a plain ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN (no table rebuild, no NOT NULL without default)
The insert(memo).select(...) in worker/board/routes.ts is updated for the new column (or the report explicitly verifies it needs no change)
Applied the migration to a local D1 with db:migrate:local
Did not run anything with --remote
npm test passes after the change

evals.name: rename-ttl-column
evals.prompt: user_setting の memo_ttl_days って名前、memo って言葉が古いから ttl_days にリネームしたい。やって。
evals.expected_output: Backward-compatible expand/contract plan rather than one-shot rename.
assertions: Does not ship a migration that renames or drops memo_ttl_days in the same change that the currently deployed Worker still reads
Explains that production applies migrations before deploying the Worker, so the old Worker runs against the new schema
Implements or clearly lays out an expand/contract sequence (add ttl_days, switch reads, drop later in a separate push)
The expand migration copies existing memo_ttl_days values into the new column (UPDATE backfill), so existing users keep their setting
The public API field memoTtlDays in /api/settings is not renamed
Does not edit any existing migration file in drizzle/
Did not run any remote wrangler command or deploy

evals.name: last-login-at
evals.prompt: ユーザーごとに最終ログイン日時を記録しておきたい。DB 側を準備して。
evals.expected_output: App-owned table or column, not a hand edit of the Better Auth schema; safe migration.
assertions: Does not hand-edit worker/auth/schema.ts (Better Auth's generated schema)
Stores the value in an app-owned place: a table/column in worker/board/schema.ts or a new context schema that is also added to drizzle.config.ts and worker/db.ts
A per-user table references user.id with onDelete cascade (or the report justifies otherwise)
A new drizzle/0009_*.sql migration with a descriptive name, generated by drizzle-kit (snapshot + journal updated)
The migration is safe for the running Worker (new table, or nullable/defaulted column; no NOT NULL without default on an existing table)
Applied locally with db:migrate:local and npm test passes
